label: killed by perpetrator
definition: Person X or explicitly affected members of population X were killed by perpetrator Y or explicitly identified agents of Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit killed-by or murder-by with correct victim and perpetrator roles; explicit killing by the named authority soldiers or troops; historical killing of identified members of a population. Excludes: geographic death-place; occupation or hostility alone; shooting or injury without established death; a population assertion interpreted as death of every member. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear victim or perpetrator attachment; unresolved identity of troops or agents; shooting where fatal outcome is unspecified. This direction is victim to perpetrator. The evaluation concerns textual support only; it does not independently adjudicate historical responsibility.

facts.reason: Palestinians → Israel: Explicit killed-by and killed-by-soldiers/troops paths identify affected Palestinian victims and the named perpetrator/agents. Occupation and nonfatal-shooting rows are ancillary.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
